doc.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: What the Army gave him: self-discipline
summary: He says the Army gave him self-discipline.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Do you think you’ve retained any qualities or any training from the Army? Has any of that served you in this life as a musician?

Well it gave me a certain understanding of self-discipline. We all have to have that if we intend to grow up and mature as a man or as a person. You know, here you got a horn you say, “Do you know how to play it? I see you got a horn but do you know how to play it?” (Laughs) Somebody has to be…like some people can give it out but they can’t take it. It’s sort of like that
